visual.detailed_description: Two grayscale cross-sectional abdominal images are shown side by side, each cropped around the upper abdomen with a black background and curved body wall at the edges; rib cross-sections appear as small bright ovals at the margins. The image on the left shows a large rounded, heterogeneous, mildly brighter region within the liver on the left side of the image, with bright contrast-filled vessels and bowel loops in the centre and a large organ with brighter tissue on the right side of the image. The image on the right shows a different cross-section with the liver spanning the upper part, bowel loops and mesenteric vessels below it, and a large organ on the right side of the image with contrast-filled vessels at its hilum; no comparable large rounded region is evident in this slice. No panel letters, arrows, side markers, scale bars, measurements or burned-in text are visible.

visual.general_description: Hematoxylin and eosin-stained liver tissue field with pink hepatocytes, three thin black arrows and one thick black arrow.
visual.detailed_description: A pink-and-purple stained tissue field at low-to-medium power shows sheets of hepatocytes with round purple nuclei and pale pink cytoplasm, thin interspersed sinusoid-like spaces with a few red blood cells, and scattered small clusters of dark purple-stained cells. Three thin black arrows are present on the left side: the upper arrow points rightward toward a gland-like structure with a pale central space containing faint granular material, the middle arrow points rightward toward an oval pale lumen with fine granular material, and the lower arrow points leftward toward another pale lumen at the lower left. One thick black arrow at the right points rightward toward a large round empty white lumen with a thin wall lined by flat cells and a rim of pink tissue. The top edge of the field shows a pale empty background at its upper left. No scale bar, panel letters or printed text is visible.

visual.general_description: Two side-by-side stained liver tissue fields: a pink H&E-style field with a pale lumen and fibrous band, and a field with blue-stained fibrous tissue.
visual.detailed_description: Two microscopic fields are shown side by side with no printed labels. The left field is pink and purple stained and shows an irregular elongated pale lumen running from the upper left toward the lower centre, surrounded by bands of pink fibrous tissue with scattered small purple nuclei, with hepatocyte cords at the left and right margins and small round pale spaces at the lower left. The right field shows a wide band of blue-stained fibrous tissue running from the upper right toward the lower left, with several small round thick-walled structures near its lower centre and a pink-red hepatocyte field above and below the band; a pale empty region is at the lower left. No scale bar, arrows, panel letters or printed text is visible.
